incidents.title: Payment API Redis Timeout and High Latency
incidents.symptoms: API response time at 7.5 seconds, Redis timeout errors, 18% error rate, 504 gateway timeouts

incidents.title: Payment API Redis Timeout and High Latency
incidents.symptoms: API response time at 7.5 seconds, Redis timeout errors, 18% error rate, 504 gateway timeouts
incidents.root_cause: Redis connection pool exhausted at peak load - 250/250 connections in use
actions_taken: Checked connection pool metrics - fully saturated
Added circuit breaker for graceful degradation
incidents.resolution: Increased Redis connection pool from 250 to 400 connections, added circuit breaker
incidents.outcome: API latency reduced from 7.5s to 800ms, error rate dropped to 0.3%
incidents.lessons_learned: Connection pool from INC-1006 (400) was still insufficient during holiday traffic. Consider auto-scaling pool size based on traffic.

incidents.title: Payment API experiencing severe latency
incidents.symptoms:
High API latency
Database connection timeouts
Connection pool utilization near 100%
Intermittent payment request failures
incidents.root_cause:
Database connection pool exhaustion caused by
a connection leak in the payment service.
actions_taken: Database connection utilization returned to normal
and payment API latency dropped back to approximately
1 second. Payment requests are succeeding normally.
incidents.resolution:
Fixed the database connection leak and restarted
the affected service instances. Increased monitoring
for connection pool utilization.

incidents.title: Payment API experiencing severe latency
incidents.symptoms: The payment API is experiencing severe latency and intermittent request failures in production. Response times have increased from around 1 second to 8-10 seconds. Monitoring shows a large number of database connection timeout errors and active database connections are close to the configured connection pool limit. The issue started approximately 20 minutes ago and is affecting payment requests.
incidents.error_logs: Database connection timeout errors, connection pool near capacity
